name: push_adb_file
description: Push one local file to an absolute device path. A device-mutating tool: checks for an existing device file before transfer and refuses it unless overwrite is explicitly requested; this check is not an atomic create and another process can create the path before adb writes. When the device provides sha256sum, the transfer is verified by comparing it with the local digest.

device_path.description: Absolute destination path on the device

local_path.description: Existing local regular file to push

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing device file; refused by default

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it
